text:
mira-bot: nightly-eval-alert: pset_v3 showed +11.8% rerank false-positive rate on reranker_e2e compared to pset_v2. Link: https://evals.internal/redwood/pset-v3/summary
Anita: saw the alert, thanks. quick glance at diffs shows two examples were merged into one in pset v3 splitter step
Sam: can you paste the diff? curious if it's a content change or metadata label shift
Anita: here's the minimal diff we saw:
```diff
- id: 241
- prompt: "Which product is being described?"
- label: ProductA
+ id: 241
+ prompt: "Which product is being described?"
+ label: ProductB
```
Lee: ah that explains a rerank flip - example label changed. but why spike only on reranker_e2e and not classifier_v1?
Jordyn: reranker is sensitive to anchor examples and ranking pairs; if that example was used as a positive pair for ProductA previously, flipping label would cascade to many pairwise scores
Theo: we also changed the negative-sampler in pset_v3 (shard-based sampler) around the same time. could be interaction effect.
Anita: good point. I pulled a quick A/B: run reranker_e2e on subset with old labels vs new labels, effect matches the nightly delta (large rank swaps for ~900 examples)
Sam: propose options: 1) revert that single label change in pset_v3 and re-run nightly, 2) rebaseline reranker with new pset (accept drift), 3) exclude anchor examples from reranker training. thoughts?
Jordyn: 1 looks low-risk and quick. we should confirm whether label change was intentional (authoring bug) or a schema transformation side-effect from the splitter script
Anita: pinging @Theo to check commit history of the splitter script and the human author. Theo: any idea?
Theo: looked at PR history — the label mapping logic in splitter.py had a fallback mapping bug for ambiguous product tokens; a recent cleanup inadvertently mapped "ProductA" tokens to canonical "ProductB" in one branch. Not intentional.
Sam: ok so bug caused label flips. recommend revert for now and add test to prevent label canonicalization for product tokens without explicit mapping
Jordyn: agree. also add a smoke eval harness that runs reranker e2e on a small anchor set before merging promptpack changes
Anita: I'll open a PR to revert the change and kick a quick eval job. tagging @mira-bot to trigger nightly re-run after merge :thumbsup:
mira-bot: scheduled rerun queued by Anita. ETA ~12m. Notifying when complete.
Sam: thanks — if rerun confirms regression gone, we'll fast-track approval. If not, we'll escalate to model-onboarding to check reranker sensitivity and consider targeted rebaseline
Lee: note for release notes: mention pset_v3 patch that reverts canonicalization bug and the added smoke check
Anita: creating PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/pset/commit/ae7f9d - adding unit + smoke tests
Theo: will review. thanks everyone.
Sam: good triage. keeping this thread for approvals once rerun finishes.
